title: Guide the transition from donor to accountable domestic financing
requirements:
- Describe a phased transition with milestones
- Describe the sustainability target as predictable, accountable, resilient financing under national governance
- Set expectations that partner investments use the national architecture, open interfaces and conformance criteria
- Cover contribution formulas, decision rights and a single accountable authority
- Cover fiscal-risk scenarios if domestic financing does not grow
- Recognise regional shared services, pooled and long-term partner financing as legitimate
- Describe cost-allocation and attribution mechanisms that let programme funders support shared components
- Offer alternatives where multi-year budget lines are hard
